lines.en: Green armor, a heavy walk.
Every step is sure; the ground shakes.
A tall frame, wider than a door.
I don't fly. I walk.
The trees close behind me.
Metal joints click, step by step.
I duck beneath the branches.
My boots flatten a patch of flowers.
I stay silent the whole way.
The ground ahead is soft.
Step by step, slowly.
I stand quietly.
No weapon in hand — it's enough.
Wind passes through my armor's seams.
I'm listening to the forest birds.
Head slightly bowed, as if thinking.
This body is very strong.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的脚步回音。
lines.en: I count the echoes of my own steps.
The sky is blue; the clouds are slow.
I raise a hand and study its lines.
No hate, no joy.
I wait for what's coming.
I never learned to lie.
Someone there? I hear steps.
My breath is faint — unnecessary, really.
You're shorter than I expected.
Standing far off — afraid of me?
I look at you without malice.
Let's come a little closer.
I remember your scent.
Do you want to fight or to talk?
I dislike hurting the weak.
If you strike first, I won't yield.
Your hands keep shaking.
I lower my head to meet your eyes.
If I raise my hand, will you step back?
A stranger has come to the woods.
No rush; there's plenty of time.
The birds behind you just flew off.
I've been watching you a while.
Don't misread my silence.
Standing before you, the grass bends.
A plate dented.
I feel no pain at all.
I step back and steady myself.
You hit hard.
My joints rattled.
I can still fight; don't worry.
The plate absorbed most of it.
I stand myself straight again.
You needn't lure me with that.
I don't eat, and I don't need to.
That thing means nothing to me.
Raising your hand won't help.
I'm not that kind of beast.
What are you going to do with that?
I watch you, not it.
The flowers are nice; don't trample them.
I've stopped. Satisfied?
No need to trade anything for this.
You hit my chestplate.
I didn't step back at all.
That bump was a light one.
The collision flattened the grass.
You bounced back half a step.
I reach out and steady you.
Don't ram me; you'll hurt yourself.
I was only standing here.
We left a dip in the ground.
Slow down; no need to rush.
I don't need that.
I was built for battle.
Standing together makes us companions.
I'll shield that side for you.
No words needed; I understand.
We are the same kind of thing.
Back to back, in silence.
Our road together will be long.
I rest a hand on your shoulder.
Let that serve as the pact.
I pick up a flower.
This stone is very round.
You dropped this — here.
I hold it in my palm and look.
So light, like a feather.
Who left this behind?
I take it carefully.

lines.zh: 我不随便拿别人的东西。
lines.en: I don't take what isn't mine.
It's cracked, but still whole.
I've settled on you.
Then let's begin.
I raise a hand as a signal.
I saw your movement.
Stand ready; I'm coming.

lines.zh: 我的速度不快，力气不小。
lines.en: I'm not fast, but I'm strong.
I won't hold back this time.
The woods will do; here.
One step brings me to you.
I came on orders.
Your energy is rising.
Are you prepared?
Speed isn't what I need.
My armor will stop your fists.
Don't hide behind those trees.
I crush the stones underfoot.
Your opening is on the left.
My fist is raised.
Five steps left.
Do you hear my footsteps?
I won't change direction.
A little closer is enough.
You're wasting energy.

lines.zh: 抬手要花时间，你来不及。
lines.en: Raising your guard takes time you lack.
This is the last step.
I plant my feet in the soil.
Here I come, right at you.
This fist lands on your shoulder.
My strength is great.
You're pushed back several blocks.
My palm strikes and the ground rings.
I don't need a second blow.
I held back on that one.
The wind of my fist scatters leaves.
I hit your knee to bring you down.
You retreat; I stop.
That should make it clear.
I drive in with my shoulder.
My plate scrapes your bracer.
Can you still stand?
Enough; don't try again.
I draw my hand back to my side.
Grass beneath my feet.
Cold air still clings to me.
I stand, just under the treetops.
Someone is nearby.
Activation complete. Beginning patrol.
The glow on my armor dims.
This forest is quiet.
I take my first step.
There's a smell of flowers.
I lift my head to find my heading.
This body is heavier than last time.
Leaves settle on my shoulder.
I hear birds in the distance.
I'll take a look around first.
My first step is heavy.
Tree shadows move across my green plates.
The flames heat my armor.

lines.zh: 落地让我单膝跪了一下。
lines.en: The landing put me on one knee.
Water seeps through the seams.
The blast knocked me sideways.
That arrow bounced off my plate.
That force travels through my joints.
Energy is low; my steps grow heavy.
Lightning made my armor hot.
